data.name: Paddling in Paradise: Ranger-Guided Kayaking on Florida Bay
data.description:
On this three-hour program on Florida Bay, you will be guided by park rangers through the mangrove estuaries and marine ecosystem. You will get opportunities to experience the Everglades wilderness and its diverse habitats, animals, and human history.

This trip can be extremely strenuous! Therefore, all participants are required to be at least 16 years old. Please consider your abilities and only sign up if you are physically fit and have prior kayaking experience.
data.itinerary:
* Meet Park Rangers at the Flamingo Marina's Florida Bay boat ramp, located at the end of Main Park Road, about 40 miles away from the park’s Homestead entrance. This will take about 60 minutes from the entrance gate.
* Advance reservations are required.
* Please arrive 30 minutes prior to the program start time to check-in (8 am).
* 12 people maximum (6 two-person kayaks). You must share a two-person kayak with a member of your own party. Single person or odd number party bookings are limited.
* At the Marina Store, you can find restrooms, water fountains, and a convenience store. The Guy Bradley Visitor Center also has bathrooms and water fountains.
data.what_is_included: All paddling equipment will be provided including life jackets, which everyone is required to wear, and paddles. Kayaks are heavy, and we may ask you to help us lift or relocate them.
data.what_to_bring:
* All paddlers are required to bring plenty of water and closed-toe shoes with good tread.
* We also recommend bringing the following:
    - Sunscreen
    - Hat
    - Sunglasses
    - Bug spray or bug jacket
    - Snacks
    - Paddling gloves
    - Breathable long pants and long-sleeve shirt
    - Binoculars
data.cancellation_notes:
Please be courteous and cancel with as much advance notice as possible so we can open your spot to other visitors.

We will only cancel the trip if there is severe weather preventing us from leading a safe experience. You will receive notification via email as well as a phone call. Conditions that may result in a cancellation include thunderstorms, lightning, or high winds. The trip could also be canceled if there is not enough water to safely follow the route.
data.booking_notes:
**Paddling in Paradise: Ranger-Guided Kayak on Florida Bay**

**Where to Meet:**
Please meet us at the Flamingo Marina (Florida Bay side), about 60 minutes from the Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center in Homestead. 
ADDRESS: 1 Flamingo Lodge Highway, Flamingo, FL 33034

**When to Meet:** 
We ask that you arrive by 8 am to take care of last-minute logistics, sign your waivers, and prepare to paddle. If you do not check-in with a ranger by 8:15 am, your place on the tour may be forfeited to other visitors. If you miss the 8:30 am safety talk, you are not permitted on the paddle.

**What to Bring:**
* Water (required)
* Closed-toe shoes with good tread (required)
* Snacks
* Hat
* Sunglasses
* Sunscreen
* Bug spray or bug jacket
* Binoculars
* Towel
* Dry bags
* Breathable long-sleeve shirt and long pants

**Important Reminders:**
* Prior paddling experience, water, and closed-toe shoes with strong tread are required. If rangers don’t feel you can complete the trip safely, they may ask you to remove yourself from the trip.
* All minors (16+) must have an adult (18+) in the kayak with them.
* Everyone will be issued life jackets and are required to wear them for the entire paddle.
* All visitors are required to sign a waiver. Parents or legal guardians can sign for minors.
* You may be asked to help us lift or move kayaks short distances.
* Plan to get wet. You may want to leave valuables, such as phones or cameras, behind so they don’t get wet. A park ranger will bring a dry bag for your car keys but will not carry any other belongings for you. The park and its rangers are not responsible for any damage to your personal belongings.

We look forward to seeing you in the ‘Glades soon!
data.check_in_details:
You will check-in with a park ranger at the Florida Bay Marina, about 40 miles past the Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center. Allow up to 60 minutes for this drive. Follow signs for Flamingo. 

Please arrive at least 30 minutes early to check-in (arrive by 8 am). If you are late, we reserve the right to give another visitor your place.

Upon arrival, you will be required to sign a waiver before joining the tour.

Adults over the age of 18 must complete and submit their own waiver. Minors ages 17 and younger must have a parent or legal guardian sign a waiver on behalf of the minor. All minors must have an adult in the kayak with them.
data.special_requirements:
* For the safety of all guests, we require that all participants are 16 years and older. 
* You must have prior paddling experience for this strenuous trip. You will be paddling for at least three hours with very few stops. You must paddle the whole time. Before the trip begins, we will require that you demonstrate paddling proficiency.
* All minors must have an adult in their kayak with them. Kayaks hold a maximum of two people.
* This ranger-led program is designed for active adults and children over 16 who are good paddlers and in good physical condition. Paddling on Florida Bay can be an extremely strenuous activity during tidal changes or swift currents. Please carefully consider your abilities before registering.
* The kayaks are plastic with little-to-no back support. 
* You may be asked to assist us in lifting and/or moving the kayaks.
* To best accommodate you and make your trip safe and enjoyable, please make a note in your reservation or privately notify park rangers if:
    - You have had any recent surgeries
    - You have any back injuries
    - You have any medical conditions or allergies
    - You are pregnant
    - You have other concerns regarding your safety or health
